scene_description: A classroom scene showing a smiling female teacher standing in front of a green chalkboard with math problems written on it. Several children are seated at desks with their hands raised. The teacher's name 'Ms. Smith' is written on the board.

questions.question: Who is standing in front of the chalkboard?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the person standing in front of the big green board.

questions.question: What are the kids doing with their hands?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the children sitting at the desks and what their arms are doing.

questions.question: Where are the teacher and kids?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the chalkboard, desks, and the whole room around them.

questions.question: What is the chalkboard used for?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is written on the big green board behind the teacher.

questions.question: What might the teacher do next when she sees all the raised hands?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the teacher's face and all the hands that are raised.

optional_extension_questions.question: Do you raise your hand at school when you know the answer?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about what you do in your classroom when you want to answer.
